title: Staged assurance sprint allocator and rolling checkpoints for SSO & audit-retention
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a phased milestone allocator that breaks the overall compliance work (SSO/SAML enablement, audit log retention pipeline, SOC2 evidence buckets) into rolling sprint-sized checkpoints. The goal is to enable incremental verification for external auditors and internal stakeholders while minimizing cross-team blocking and reducing last-minute evidence fixes.
scope: Define 6-week phased milestones with 2-week sprint checkpoints
Produce an evidence backlog and mapping to controls for SOC2/ISO
Add console flags and rollout gates to validate SSO cutover and audit-log retention in Dedicated and Private deployments
Automate evidence capture where possible (daily exports, PRD/GH links, test runs)
milestones: M1: Baseline control mapping & evidence backlog (2025-09-24)
M2: SSO integration test harness + canary plan (2025-10-08)
M3: Audit-log retention pipeline v1 + export automation (2025-10-29)
M4: SOC2 evidence preflight + sample audit run (2025-11-12)
M5: Final verification and handoff to compliance (2025-11-15)
tasks: Gather control owners and map each evidence artifact to a Linear ticket
Design canary rollback policy for SSO cutover (console flag + telemetry checks)
Implement daily audit-log snapshot exports to secure evidence bucket
Add telemetry and alerting for missing evidence (per-control health checks)
Author the milestone acceptance checklist and attach to each sprint ticket
acceptance_criteria: Every milestone has a linked evidence artifact or automation script
Canary SSO cutover runs in staging and dedicated with rollback tested
Audit-log retention pipeline produces verifiable daily snapshots for 90 days
Compliance team confirms control mapping is sufficient for auditor review
Release gating is configured in Console with pass/fail queries and owner contacts
risks: Dependency on infra team for audit-log ingestion could delay M3
Third-party SAML provider edge-cases may require additional compatibility work
Manual evidence collection is error-prone and could increase audit prep time
Tight timeline for SOC2 preflight if upstream dependencies slip
